---
title: "Search by meaning"
subtitle: "Find a section by what you are trying to do, in English or Danish"
date: last-modified
pagetitle: "Search by meaning"
description: "Search the guide by what you are trying to do, in English or Danish. It knows synonyms and register terms: moves abroad finds emigration, uddannelse finds hfaudd."
---

The guide has two searches. The search box in the top bar finds the exact words
you type. The search on this page also looks for synonyms and for the English
term behind a Danish word, and it takes you to the section, not just the page:
*moves abroad* finds emigration, *uddannelse* finds `hfaudd`, and a pasted error
message finds the table row that explains it.

It works from a hand-written list of synonyms, not from a language model. A
word that is not on the list is matched as you typed it (small typing errors
are corrected). If a search that should have worked comes up empty, write it in
the feedback box on this page and the word gets added.

Looking for a column rather than an explanation? [Find a
variable](find-a-variable.qmd) searches every column in every register.

```{=html}
<div id="gsearch" role="search">
  <label for="gs-q" class="gs-label">What are you trying to do?</label>
  <input id="gs-q" type="search" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false"
         aria-describedby="gs-count"
         placeholder="For example: people who move abroad">
  <p id="gs-count" class="gs-count" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
  <div id="gs-results"></div>
  <noscript><p class="gs-empty">This search needs JavaScript. The search box in
  the top bar does too; without it, use the contents list on the left.</p></noscript>
</div>

<style>
#gsearch { margin: 1.5rem 0; }
.gs-label { display: block; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: .35rem; }
#gs-q { width: 100%; padding: .7rem .9rem; font-size: 1.05rem; border-radius: 6px;
        border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #6c757d); background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff);
        color: var(--bs-body-color, #111); }
.gs-count { font-size: .9rem; margin: .7rem 0 0; min-height: 1.4em; }
.gs-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
.gs-hit { border-top: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ddd); padding: .9rem 0; }
.gs-where { font-size: .85rem; }
.gs-head { font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 600; margin: .15rem 0; }
.gs-snip { font-size: .9rem; margin: .25rem 0 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.gs-snip mark { background: rgba(255, 214, 0, .35); color: inherit; padding: 0 .1em; }
.gs-empty { padding: 1rem 0; }
.gs-examples { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .5rem; padding: 0; margin: .5rem 0 0; list-style: none; }
.gs-examples button { border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #6c757d); background: transparent;
        color: inherit; border-radius: 999px; padding: .3rem .8rem; font-size: .9rem; cursor: pointer; }
.gs-examples button:hover { background: rgba(127, 127, 127, .15); }
</style>

<script>
(function () {
  var SECTIONS = [], GROUPS = [], VOCAB = {};

  // Shown while the box is empty. One of each kind of search the page is
  // meant for: a lay phrase, Danish, a register name, an error message.
  var EXAMPLES = ["people who move abroad", "dødsårsag", "hvordan kobler jeg registre",
    "matched controls", "hfaudd", "could not find function", "small numbers in a table"];

  // How much a match counts, depending on where it is. A word in the section
  // heading says the section is about it; a word in the text only says it is
  // mentioned. The page title counts most on the entry for the top of the
  // page (so "lpr" lands on the page about LPR) and little on the sections
  // further down, which all share that title.
  var HEADING = 10, TITLE_TOP = 12, TITLE_BELOW = 2, CODE = 2, BODY = 2;
  // A synonym counts for less than the word the reader typed.
  var SYNONYM = 0.6;
  // The whole query found word for word, as with a pasted error message.
  var PHRASE_HEADING = 20, PHRASE_BODY = 12;
  // Headings of sections that only point to other pages (see search()).
  var SIGNPOST = /^(\d+ )?(see also|next steps?)\b/;

  // One spelling for comparing: lower case, the Danish letters written out
  // (people type both "indlæggelse" and "indlaeggelse"), and everything that
  // is not a letter, a digit or "_" turned into a space. So "follow-up" and
  // "follow up" are the same, and so are "as.Date" and "as date".
  function norm(s) {
    return String(s == null ? "" : s).toLowerCase()
      .replace(/æ/g, "ae").replace(/ø/g, "oe").replace(/å/g, "aa")
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9_]+/g, " ").trim();
  }

  // Words that say nothing about the subject. Without this list, "folk der
  // flytter til udlandet" matches almost every section, because "der" and
  // "til" are everywhere. "find" and "get" are here because every search is
  // about finding something.
  var STOP = norm("a about am an and are as at be been but by can did do does " +
    "find for from get has have how i if in into is it its me my need not of on " +
    "or people person should someone that the their then there they this to " +
    "use want was were what when where which who why will with would you your " +
    "af alle at blev bliver bruge da de den der det dette du eller en er et " +
    "finde finder for fra få gør har hvad hvem hvis hvor hvordan hvorfor hvornår " +
    "hvilke hvilken i ikke jeg kan man med mig min mine og om på selv skal som " +
    "til ved vi").split(" ");

  var q = document.getElementById("gs-q"),
      out = document.getElementById("gs-results"),
      count = document.getElementById("gs-count");

  // A search can be opened from a link: search.html?query=death. The name is
  // "query" and not "q", because Quarto's own search script also uses "q" and
  // deletes it from the address before this script runs. "q" is still read,
  // in case it ever survives.
  var params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  var linked = params.get("query") || params.get("q");

  // Keep the address in step with the box, so it can be copied as a link to
  // this search. replaceState changes the address without adding a step to
  // the browser history, so Back still leaves the page in one press instead
  // of undoing the query one letter at a time.
  function updateAddress() {
    var text = q.value.trim();
    history.replaceState(null, "", location.pathname +
      (text ? "?query=" + encodeURIComponent(text) : ""));
  }

  function esc(s) {
    return String(s == null ? "" : s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function (c) {
      return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" }[c];
    });
  }

  // Danish inflects and compounds: "stien" should reach "sti", and
  // "doedsdato" should reach "doed". English inflects too: a reader types
  // "move abroad" or "moves abroad", the synonym list says "moved abroad". A
  // shared start with a bounded leftover on each side covers all of that:
  // -en, -et, -erne, -ed, -es and a joined second word, without letting
  // "kom" swallow "kommunikation". The exact limits are at the end of the
  // function. Both words must already be in the norm() spelling.
  function stemMatch(term, w) {
    if (w === term) return true;
    if (term.length < 3 || w.length < 3) return false;
    // Shared prefix rather than strict containment, so "moves" reaches
    // "moved" even though neither word contains the other outright.
    var n = 0, max = Math.min(term.length, w.length);
    while (n < max && term[n] === w[n]) n++;
    // What each word has left after the shared start: the shorter leftover
    // (less) and the longer one (more).
    var less = Math.min(term.length - n, w.length - n),
        more = Math.max(term.length - n, w.length - n);
    // One word is the start of the other. If the synonym is the short one
    // ("sti", typed "stien") the typed word may add six letters, which covers
    // Danish endings and compounds. If the typed word is the short one it
    // may lack only three, so "log" reaches "login" but not "logistic".
    if (less === 0) return more <= (w.length < term.length ? 3 : 6);
    // Each word has its own ending: "moves" and "moved". Then four letters
    // must be shared and the shorter ending is at most two. Before, three
    // shared letters and six left on both sides were enough, so "indkomst"
    // matched "indvandr" and "results" matched "resident", and a search for
    // income also looked for immigration.
    return n >= 4 && less <= 2 && more <= 6;
  }

  // How a term is looked for in a section: at the start of a word. Plain
  // "contains" found "ram" in "program" and "age" in "page". A term may
  // continue ("join" finds "joins"), and "_" starts a word too ("join" finds
  // "left_join"). A term of three letters or fewer must be the whole word,
  // so "bef" does not find "before"; a digit may follow ("lpr" finds "lpr3").
  function finder(term) {
    return new RegExp("(?:^|[ _])" + term + (term.length <= 3 ? "(?![a-z])" : ""), "g");
  }
  function times(re, text) {
    var n = 0;
    re.lastIndex = 0;
    while (re.exec(text)) n++;
    return n;
  }

  // Turn what was typed into "concepts": one per word that carries meaning,
  // each with the word itself and the synonyms it brought along. Keeping the
  // synonyms with their word is what lets a section that covers every typed
  // word come before one that repeats a single word many times.
  function expand(query) {
    var raw = query.toLowerCase();
    var words = norm(raw).split(" ").filter(Boolean);
    var kept = words.filter(function (w) { return STOP.indexOf(w) === -1 && w.length > 1; });
    if (!kept.length) kept = words;  // a query of nothing but stop words

    var concepts = kept.map(function (w) {
      // Plural "s" off, so "deaths" looks for "death". The search is for the
      // start of a word, so "death" still finds "deaths" in the text.
      var look = (w.length >= 5 && /[^s]s$/.test(w)) ? w.slice(0, -1) : w;
      return { word: w, typed: [look], synonyms: [] };
    });
    var via = [];

    function attach(concept, group, term) {
      group.forEach(function (g) {
        if (g.norm && concept.typed.indexOf(g.norm) === -1 &&
            concept.synonyms.indexOf(g.norm) === -1) concept.synonyms.push(g.norm);
      });
      if (via.indexOf(term.raw) === -1) via.push(term.raw);
    }

    GROUPS.forEach(function (group) {
      group.forEach(function (term) {
        if (term.symbol) {
          // A term like "%>%" or "!!" has no letters to compare, so look
          // for it in the query exactly as typed. It becomes a concept of
          // its own, because no typed word stands for it.
          if (raw.indexOf(term.raw) === -1) return;
          var own = { word: term.raw, typed: [], synonyms: [] };
          concepts.push(own);
          attach(own, group, term);
          return;
        }
        var parts = term.norm.split(" ");
        // A synonym of several words, like "moved abroad", is matched word
        // by word, order and tense free of each other, so "people who move
        // abroad" reaches it. Compared with every typed word (words), not
        // only the ones kept for searching: "log in" and "table 1" contain
        // a small word or a digit that is otherwise left out.
        var all = parts.every(function (p) {
          return words.some(function (w) { return stemMatch(p, w); });
        });
        if (!all) return;
        concepts.forEach(function (c) {
          if (parts.some(function (p) { return stemMatch(p, c.word); })) attach(c, group, term);
        });
      });
    });
    return { words: words, concepts: concepts, via: via };
  }

  // Small typing errors: "emmigration", "comorbidty". If a typed word of five
  // letters or more starts no word in the guide and no synonym, swap it for
  // the closest word that does exist: one wrong letter for short words, two
  // for words of eight letters or more, and the same first letter.
  function editDistance(a, b) {
    var prev = [], cur = [], i, j;
    for (j = 0; j <= b.length; j++) prev[j] = j;
    for (i = 1; i <= a.length; i++) {
      cur = [i];
      for (j = 1; j <= b.length; j++) {
        cur[j] = Math.min(prev[j] + 1, cur[j - 1] + 1,
                          prev[j - 1] + (a[i - 1] === b[j - 1] ? 0 : 1));
      }
      prev = cur;
    }
    return prev[b.length];
  }
  function closestWord(w) {
    var allowed = w.length >= 8 ? 2 : 1, best = null, bestD = allowed + 1;
    Object.keys(VOCAB).forEach(function (v) {
      if (v[0] !== w[0] || Math.abs(v.length - w.length) > allowed) return;
      var d = editDistance(w, v);
      if (d < bestD || (d === bestD && best && VOCAB[v] > VOCAB[best])) { best = v; bestD = d; }
    });
    return best;
  }
  function correctTypos(query) {
    var fixed = [];
    var e = expand(query);
    var known = Object.keys(VOCAB);
    e.concepts.forEach(function (c) {
      var w = c.typed[0];
      if (!w || w.length < 5 || c.synonyms.length) return;
      if (known.some(function (v) { return v.indexOf(w) === 0; })) return;
      var better = closestWord(w);
      if (better) fixed.push({ from: c.word, to: better });
    });
    if (!fixed.length) return { query: query, fixed: fixed };
    var words = norm(query).split(" ").map(function (w) {
      var f = fixed.filter(function (x) { return x.from === w; })[0];
      return f ? f.to : w;
    });
    return { query: words.join(" "), fixed: fixed };
  }

  // Score every section for a query. Returns the sections that match, best
  // first.
  function search(query) {
    var e = expand(query);
    // The project pages for DARTER are notes for one project. They are left
    // out unless the search names the project.
    var project = /darter|708421/.test(query.toLowerCase());
    var pool = SECTIONS.filter(function (sec) { return project || !sec.project; });

    // Give every term its finder, and a weight for how rare it is: a word
    // found in a handful of sections tells them apart, a word found in half
    // the guide ("data", "register") tells nothing. This is the usual
    // inverse document frequency, scaled to lie between 0 and 1.
    function prepare(term, factor) {
      var re = finder(term), found = 0;
      pool.forEach(function (sec) {
        re.lastIndex = 0;
        if (re.test(sec.all)) found++;
      });
      return { re: re, weight: factor * Math.log(1 + pool.length / (1 + found)) /
                                        Math.log(1 + pool.length) };
    }
    e.concepts.forEach(function (c) {
      c.terms = c.typed.map(function (t) { return prepare(t, 1); })
        .concat(c.synonyms.map(function (t) { return prepare(t, SYNONYM); }));
    });
    var phrase = e.words.length > 1 ? finder(e.words.join(" ")) : null;

    var hits = [];
    pool.forEach(function (sec) {
      var total = 0, covered = 0;
      e.concepts.forEach(function (c) {
        var best = 0, rest = 0;
        c.terms.forEach(function (t) {
          var s = 0;
          if (times(t.re, sec.head)) s += HEADING;
          if (times(t.re, sec.title)) s += sec.heading ? TITLE_BELOW : TITLE_TOP;
          if (times(t.re, sec.code)) s += CODE;
          // The first mention in the text counts fully, the next ones less
          // and less: a long section should not win only by being long.
          var n = times(t.re, sec.body);
          if (n) s += BODY * (1 + Math.log(n));
          s *= t.weight;
          if (s > best) { rest += best; best = s; } else rest += s;
        });
        // A concept counts by its best term, plus a little for each further
        // synonym found. Adding them all up let a concept with twelve
        // synonyms outweigh a typed word that has none.
        if (best > 0) { covered++; total += best + 0.25 * rest; }
      });
      if (!total) return;
      // A section that covers every typed concept comes before one that
      // covers half of them, however often it repeats that half.
      var share = covered / e.concepts.length;
      total *= share * share;
      if (phrase) {
        if (times(phrase, sec.head)) total += PHRASE_HEADING;
        else if (times(phrase, sec.body)) total += PHRASE_BODY;
      }
      // "See also" and "Next steps" sections are lists of other pages. They
      // mention every subject in a few words, so without this they came
      // first for searches such as "export results", ahead of the page they
      // point to.
      if (SIGNPOST.test(sec.head)) total *= 0.5;
      hits.push({ sec: sec, score: total });
    });
    hits.sort(function (a, b) { return b.score - a.score; });
    return { hits: hits, expanded: e };
  }

  // A stretch of the section's text around the place where most of the
  // searched words sit, with those words marked. Typed words count for more
  // than synonyms when choosing the place.
  function snippet(text, e) {
    var typed = [], other = [];
    e.concepts.forEach(function (c) {
      c.typed.forEach(function (t) { typed = typed.concat(t.split(" ")); });
      c.synonyms.forEach(function (t) { other = other.concat(t.split(" ")); });
    });
    var useful = function (w) { return w.length > 1 && STOP.indexOf(w) === -1; };
    typed = typed.filter(useful); other = other.filter(useful);
    function starts(list, piece) {
      return list.some(function (t) {
        return piece.indexOf(t) === 0 && (t.length > 3 || !/[a-z]/.test(piece.charAt(t.length)));
      });
    }
    // Every word of the text with its position, and whether it is one of
    // the searched words. "left_join" is also tried piece by piece.
    var marks = [], m, wordRe = /[\p{L}\p{N}_]+/gu;
    while ((m = wordRe.exec(text))) {
      var pieces = [norm(m[0])].concat(norm(m[0]).split("_"));
      var value = pieces.some(function (p) { return starts(typed, p); }) ? 3 :
                  pieces.some(function (p) { return starts(other, p); }) ? 1 : 0;
      if (value) marks.push({ at: m.index, end: m.index + m[0].length, value: value });
    }
    var SPAN = 260, from = 0;
    if (marks.length) {
      var bestSum = -1;
      marks.forEach(function (first) {
        var start = Math.max(0, first.at - 60), sum = 0;
        marks.forEach(function (k) { if (k.at >= start && k.end <= start + SPAN) sum += k.value; });
        if (sum > bestSum) { bestSum = sum; from = start; }
      });
    }
    var to = Math.min(text.length, from + SPAN);
    // Start and stop at a space, so the snippet does not open or close in
    // the middle of a word.
    if (from > 0) { var sp = text.indexOf(" ", from); if (sp !== -1 && sp < from + 30) from = sp + 1; }
    if (to < text.length) { var ep = text.lastIndexOf(" ", to); if (ep > from) to = ep; }
    var html = "", at = from;
    marks.forEach(function (k) {
      if (k.at < from || k.end > to) return;
      html += esc(text.slice(at, k.at)) + "<mark>" + esc(text.slice(k.at, k.end)) + "</mark>";
      at = k.end;
    });
    html += esc(text.slice(at, to));
    return (from > 0 ? "... " : "") + html + (to < text.length ? " ..." : "");
  }

  function showExamples() {
    count.textContent = "";
    out.innerHTML = '<p class="gs-empty" id="gs-try">Try one of these:</p>' +
      '<ul class="gs-examples" aria-labelledby="gs-try">' + EXAMPLES.map(function (x) {
        return '<li><button type="button" data-query="' + esc(x) + '">' + esc(x) + "</button></li>";
      }).join("") + "</ul>";
  }

  function render() {
    var text = q.value.trim();
    if (!text) { showExamples(); return; }
    var fix = correctTypos(text);
    var found = search(fix.query), hits = found.hits, e = found.expanded;

    var notes = [];
    fix.fixed.forEach(function (f) {
      notes.push('Nothing matches "' + f.from + '", searched for "' + f.to + '" instead.');
    });
    notes.push(hits.length + " section" + (hits.length === 1 ? "" : "s") + " found" +
      (hits.length > 20 ? ", the 20 best shown" : "") + ".");
    if (e.via.length) notes.push("Also searched for the synonyms of: " + e.via.slice(0, 6).join(", ") + ".");
    count.textContent = notes.join(" ");

    if (!hits.length) {
      out.innerHTML = '<p class="gs-empty">Nothing found for these words. Try one word at a time, ' +
        "or the Danish or English word for the same thing. A column name is better looked up on " +
        '<a href="find-a-variable.html">Find a variable</a>. If you expected this search to work, ' +
        "write the words in the feedback box on this page.</p>";
      return;
    }

    out.innerHTML = '<ol class="gs-list">' + hits.slice(0, 20).map(function (h) {
      var sec = h.sec;
      var href = sec.page.replace(/\.qmd$/, ".html") + (sec.anchor ? "#" + sec.anchor : "");
      return '<li class="gs-hit">' +
        '<div class="gs-where">' + esc(sec.titleText) + "</div>" +
        '<div class="gs-head"><a href="' + esc(href) + '">' +
          esc(sec.heading || sec.titleText) + "</a></div>" +
        '<p class="gs-snip">' + snippet(sec.text, e) + "</p>" +
        "</li>";
    }).join("") + "</ol>";
  }

  fetch("assets/search-index.json")
    .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
    .then(function (d) {
      // Prepare each section once, so typing does not redo it: the same
      // fields in the norm() spelling. The anchor counts as part of the
      // heading. An explicit {#fastreg-paths} is the author labelling the
      // section, and it often carries the word the reader types.
      SECTIONS = d.sections.map(function (s) {
        var sec = {
          page: s.page, anchor: s.anchor, heading: s.heading, titleText: s.title, text: s.text,
          project: /^darter-/.test(s.page),
          head: norm(s.heading + " " + s.anchor), title: norm(s.title),
          body: norm(s.text), code: norm(s.code)
        };
        sec.all = sec.head + " " + sec.title + " " + sec.body + " " + sec.code;
        return sec;
      });
      // A term with a character that norm() would remove, and no letters
      // left to compare ("%>%", "!!"), is a symbol and is matched as typed.
      GROUPS = (d.synonyms || []).map(function (group) {
        return group.map(function (t) {
          var raw = String(t).toLowerCase();
          return { raw: raw, norm: norm(raw), symbol: !/[a-zæøå]/.test(raw) && !/^\d+$/.test(raw) };
        });
      });
      // Every word the guide or the synonym list contains, with how many
      // sections use it. Used to tell a typing error from a real word.
      SECTIONS.forEach(function (sec) {
        var seen = {};
        sec.all.split(/[ _]/).forEach(function (w) {
          if (w.length >= 4 && !seen[w]) { seen[w] = 1; VOCAB[w] = (VOCAB[w] || 0) + 1; }
        });
      });
      GROUPS.forEach(function (group) {
        group.forEach(function (t) {
          t.norm.split(" ").forEach(function (w) { if (w.length >= 4 && !VOCAB[w]) VOCAB[w] = 1; });
        });
      });

      q.addEventListener("input", function () { render(); updateAddress(); });
      // The example buttons: put the text in the box and search.
      out.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
        var text = ev.target && ev.target.getAttribute && ev.target.getAttribute("data-query");
        if (!text) return;
        q.value = text; render(); updateAddress(); q.focus();
      });
      if (linked) q.value = linked;
      render();
      // Put the cursor in the box, except on a touch screen, where that
      // opens the keyboard over the page before the reader has seen it.
      if (!(typeof matchMedia === "function" && matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches)) q.focus();
    })
    .catch(function () {
      out.innerHTML = '<p class="gs-empty">The search could not be loaded just now. Reload the ' +
        "page, or use the search box in the top bar.</p>";
    });
})();
</script>
```
